content: Abirgunagwar-nikulegedgi binsaed amied
Gwenadgan, dulemar-Moisés-Igar-Maid-wismaladga an soged: We-Moisés-Igar-Maid, dule dula-gudiirbi a-Igar-Maid-urbalikwaa nanaoed.
Ome sui-nikadyobdo: E-sui dula-gudiile, abirgunagwar-nanaleged-igar-maidba suiba nanaoed. Ar e-sui burgwenonikirdi, a-igar-maidgi ollorgunonikoed. Ome, bar a-igarba nanaosulid.

Degisoggu, amba e-sui-dula-gudiidgi machered-baid-nikunonikile, we soglegodo, ome igarsuli negsichigi e-sui-dikarba yolediiye. Ar e-sui-burgwisardi, sui-nikued-igar-maidgi ollorgunonido. Degisoggu, ar sui-baid-nikunonikile, we-ome negsichigi yoledisurdo.

Gwenadgan, bemar amba deyobmodo. Cristo burgwisgu, bemar Cristoʼba-burgwisayob gunonimarmogad. A-ular, bemar Moisés-Igar-Maidgi ollorgunonimalad. Emisgindi, bemar dule-burgwisad-gannar-durgus-gusadgadga gunonikid. Adi, bemar, Bab-Dummadga ibmar-nuegan-imakmalagar.

Ar anmar-ibmar-isgana-imakbiedbarbi an gudimargua, Moisés-Igar-Maiddi, ibmar-isgana-imaked-imakega anmar-imakdedaed. Degisoggu, we, bur bule Bab-Dummadgi-banguega anmar-imaked, burgwedse anmar-seddaed.

Ar emigindi, igar-isgana-anmar-ganikidgi an burgwismarsoggu, Moisés-Igar-Maidgi an ollorgusmalad. Degisoggu, a-ular, Bab-Burba anmarga-gargangued-ukedba Bab-Dummadga arbamarsundo. Bar Moisés-Igar-sered-narmakar-maidginsurdo.
Isgued-angi-naid

Degite, ¿igi an sogmalosunna? ¿Moisés-Igar-Maid wede isguedi? Suli, degisuli. Ar Moisés-Igar-Maid maisulina, we-isgued an wisguosulinad. Ar Moisés-Igar-Maidgi sognasulina: “Mer dulemar-baid-e-ibmarbina yaisur-sogoye.” An dule-baid-ibmarbina-yaisur-soged wisguosulinad.
Ar Igar-Maid deyob sognaisoggu, isgued bela-bela dule-baid-e-ibmarbina-yaisur-soged angi nasiksad. Ar Moisés-Igar maisulina, isgued gangued sulinad. Isgued-igar burgwar mainad.
Ani, epennedi an Moisés-Igar-Maid-wissuli an gudigusad. An Moisés-Igar-Maid-wisgunonigu, isgued-angi-naid durguded. Agine, an burgwenonisunnad.
Degine, an daknonisunnad, an dula-gudiguega we-Igar-uklesadi, anga burgwedga gubali.
Ar ade, isgued, Igar-Sogmaidba an-yardaknonikid, agi, an-oburgwenonisunnad.
Degisoggu, an sogmarsunnad, Moisés-Igar-Maid-swilidikid, Bab-Dummad mesisad. Bela we-Igargan-Mamaidi nue-swilidikidid, igar-innikigwadid, degine, igar-nuedid.

Ar degite, ¿wede ibmar-nuedidde, burgwedga we-ibmar-nued anga gunonisunde? Suli, degisuli. Ar isgued, oyogegala we isguedye, anga ibmar-nuedba burgwed-uknonikid, adi, Igar-Maidba oyolegegar, we-isgued bela-bela isganaye.
Ar anmar wismalad, Moisés-Igar-Mesisad, we-igar-nuedid, burbaledid. Ar an-sandi we-napnegginedsoggu, isgued-e-maiga-guega isguedse bakles gudiid.
Ar an ibmar-imaked an aku itoged. Ar an ibmar-imakbied an imakdasulid, aka bur an ibmar-isdar-daked an imakdedaed.
Ar an ibmar-abesulid an imakele, an sognaido, we-Moisés-Igar-Maidi, nuedye.
Degisoggu, an-sunnad an ibmar-imaksursundo. An ibmar-imakedi, isgued-angi-naid ibmar-imakega an-imaked.
Degine, an nue wisid, we angi ibmar-nued naisulid. Ar ibmar-nued an imakbien-inigwele, gege an ibmar-imak itodaed.
Ar ade, ibmar-nued-an-imakbiedi, an imaksulid. Aka bur an ibmar-isgana-imakbisulidi, imakdedaed.
Ar an ibmar-imakbisulid imakele, ani an bar imaksurdo. An-ibmar-imakedi, isgued-angi-naid ibmar-imakega an-imaked.
Degisoggu, weyob igar mai an daksundo, ibmar-nued an imakbien-inigwele, isgued angi naid.
Ar an-san-burba-ulubgindi, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidgi an nue yeer itoged.
Degine, an-sangi baid-igar-mai an dakbardo. We-igar, an-binsaedgi yolenonidaed. Degisoggu, we-igarse an gales gudisunnad. An ibmar-imakedi, isguedbi an imakdisunnad.
Degisoggu, ¡nue an dule-wilesdo! ¿Doa-wede we-burgwed-angi-naid anga osulogosunna?

Ar Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye an sogsunnad. Ar mer anmar bar isguedgi nanamalaga, Bab-Dummad, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristoʼba anmar-abonoged. Degisoggu, an-sunnad an-binsaedgi Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba an mailedisunnad. Ar an-sangindi, isgued-igar-maidba an mailediid.
